headlines.name: Math115.CompletedRepairInjection.repairToChild_large_crossing
headlines.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J]
  {small : I → J → Bool} {B : I → J → ℕ} {r rbar : I → ℕ} {c cbar : J → ℕ} {s t : I × J} {σ : I × J → ℕ} {l : ℕ}
  (hs : small s.1 s.2 = true) (ht : small t.1 t.2 = true) (hst : OAI.ContingencyTables.RowMajorBefore s t),
  small t.1 s.2 = false →
    ∀ (a : Math115.CompletedRepairInjection.CompletedDefects small B r rbar c cbar s t σ l),
      ↑↑↑(Math115.CompletedRepairInjection.repairToChild hs ht hst a) t.1 s.2 = (↑↑a.snd).1 t.1 s.2 + 1 ∧
        (↑↑a.snd).1 t.1 s.2 = ↑↑↑(Math115.CompletedRepairInjection.repairToChild hs ht hst a) t.1 s.2 - 1 ∧
          (↑↑a.snd).2 t.1 s.2 = (↑↑a.snd).1 t.1 s.2

headlines.name: Math115.AggregateCorrectionCap.physical_correction_le_aggregate_adjacent
headlines.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J] (r : I → ℕ)
  (c : J → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) (B : I → J → ℕ) (s : I × J)
  (hs : OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U s.1 s.2 = true) (σ : I × J → ℕ) (l : ℕ),
  1 ≤ l →
    l ≤ U →
      (∀ (i : I) (j : J), OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U i j = true → B i j = U) →
        (∀
            (a :
              OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Earlier
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) s),
            σ ↑↑a ≤ U) →
          ∀ {n : ℕ}
            (e :
              Fin n ≃
                OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Later
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) s),
            (∀
                (A :
                  OAI.ContingencyTables.ResidualTables (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) r
                    c
                    (fun i =>
                      r i +
                        OAI.ContingencyTables.PaddedCompletions.rowLargeCount
                            (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) i *
                          L)
                    fun j =>
                    c j +
                      OAI.ContingencyTables.PaddedCompletions.columnLargeCount
                          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) j *
                        L)
                (i : I) (j : J), ↑↑A i j ≤ B i j) →
              let small := OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U;
              let Ms := OAI.ContingencyTables.LargePairEnumeration.widths fun x => U;
              have f :=
                OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstPaperContextTransport.contextHard small B r c L Ms
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.contextEquiv small s hs e U)
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextEnumeration.prefixRaw small s σ U);
              have K :=
                ↑((Research.ResidualSelectedBudget.smallLineCount r U +
                        Research.ResidualSelectedBudget.smallLineCount c U) *
                      U ^ 2 +
                    Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells small) * U);
              OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.correctionKernel Ms
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerBoxTruncation.truncate f
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.bounds (fun x => U) Ms) (U + Ms.sum))
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.ExcessContextProfiles.auxRoot U l) ≤
                2 * K *
                  max
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms f
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U (l - 1)))
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms f
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U l))

headlines.name: Math115.AggregateDefectTrace.state_variance_aggregate
headlines.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J] (r : I → ℕ)
  (c : J → ℕ) (U L : ℕ),
  2 ≤ U →
    2 ≤
        Fintype.card
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) →
      ∀ (H : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L → ℝ),
        OAI.ContingencyTables.FiniteExposureVariance.variance (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.weight r c U L) H ≤
          2 *
                ↑(Fintype.card
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U))) ^
                  2 *
              Math115.AggregateDefectTrace.aggregateCT r c U *
            Math115.ReducedSmallChain.graphEnergy r c U L H

headlines.name: Math115.AggregateDefectTrace.actualRationalTrace_poincare_aggregate
headlines.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J] (r : I → ℕ)
  (c : J → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) [inst_4 : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)],
  2 ≤ U →
    7 ≤ L →
      ∀
        (hp :
          2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
        (g : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L → ℝ),
        (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.actualRationalTrace r c U L hp).variance g ≤
          32 *
                ↑(Fintype.card
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U))) ^
                  3 *
              Math115.AggregateDefectTrace.aggregateCT r c U *
            (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.actualRationalTrace r c U L hp).energy g

  (c : J → ℕ),
  2 ≤ Fintype.card I →
    2 ≤ Fintype.card J →
      ∀ [inst_4 : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c Math115.RetainedChainSquare.squareCutoff 7)]
        (hp :
          2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c Math115.RetainedChainSquare.squareCutoff)))

          34848 * ↑OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance ^ 5 *
              ↑(Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J - 2) ^ 3 *
            (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.actualRationalTrace r c Math115.RetainedChainSquare.squareCutoff 7 hp).energy g
